cards.name: Venonat
cards.description: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.

cards.name: Talonflame
cards.description: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.

cards.name: Litleo
cards.description: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.

cards.name: Pyroar
cards.description: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.

cards.name: Krabby
cards.description: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

cards.name: Kingler
cards.description: The large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

cards.name: Totodile
cards.description: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

cards.name: Croconaw
cards.description: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

cards.name: Feraligatr
cards.description: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

cards.name: Finneon
cards.description: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.

cards.name: Lumineon
cards.description: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.

cards.name: Venomoth
cards.description: The scales it scatters will paralyze anyone who touches them, making that person unable to stand.

cards.name: Frillish
cards.description: They paralyze prey with poison, then drag them down to their lairs, five miles below the surface.

cards.name: Jellicent
cards.description: Its body is mostly seawater. It's said there's a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.

cards.name: Alomomola
cards.description: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.

cards.name: Pachirisu
cards.description: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

cards.name: Joltik
cards.description: Since it can't generate its own electricity, it sticks onto large-bodied Pokémon and absorbs static electricity.

cards.name: Galvantula
cards.description: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

cards.name: Helioptile
cards.description: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

cards.name: Helioptile
cards.description: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

cards.name: Yanma
cards.description: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won't miss prey—even those behind it.

cards.name: Heliolisk
cards.description: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.description: Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from it mouth.

cards.name: Golbat
cards.description: Once it bites, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

cards.name: Crobat
cards.description: It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.

cards.name: Wobbuffet
cards.description: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.

cards.name: Gulpin
cards.description: It has a small heart and brain. Its stomach compromises most of its body, with enzymes to dissolve anything.

cards.name: Swalot
cards.description: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.

cards.name: Munna
cards.description: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.

cards.name: Yanmega
cards.description: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes' heads instantly while flying by at high speed.

cards.name: Musharna
cards.description: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.description: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

cards.name: Lampent
cards.description: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

cards.name: Chandelure
cards.description: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

cards.name: Pumpkaboo
cards.description: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

cards.name: Gourgeist
cards.description: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.description: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

cards.name: Gliscor
cards.description: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

cards.name: Roggenrola
cards.description: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

cards.name: Boldore
cards.description: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.

cards.name: Sewaddle
cards.description: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

cards.name: Gigalith
cards.description: The solar rays it absorbs are processed in its energy core and fired as a ball of light.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.description: It hides any shiny object it finds in a secret location. Murkrow and Meowth loot one another's stashes.

cards.name: Honchkrow
cards.description: If one utters a deep cry, many Murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called "Summoner of Night."

cards.name: Poochyena
cards.description: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

cards.name: Mightyena
cards.description: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.description: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

cards.name: Purrloin
cards.description: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

cards.name: Liepard
cards.description: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.description: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

cards.name: Swadloon
cards.description: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.description: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back contained a mysterious power.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.description: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.

cards.name: Heatran
cards.description: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

cards.name: Escavalier
cards.description: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.

cards.name: Klefki
cards.description: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.

cards.name: Swirlix
cards.description: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and as sticky as cotton candy.

cards.name: Slurpuff
cards.description: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

cards.name: Leavanny
cards.description: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.description: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

cards.name: Diancie
cards.description: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

cards.name: Deino
cards.description: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.

cards.name: Zweilous
cards.description: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.

cards.name: Hydreigon
cards.description: Their heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

cards.name: Goomy
cards.description: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn't dry out.

cards.name: Sliggoo
cards.description: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can't see anything.

cards.name: Goodra
cards.description: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.

cards.name: Spearow
cards.description: Very protective of its territory, it flaps its short wings busily to dart around at high speed.

cards.name: Fearow
cards.description: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land or rest.

cards.name: Karrablast
cards.description: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.description: It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its egg with injured people.

cards.name: Blissey
cards.description: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

cards.name: Girafarig
cards.description: While it sleeps, the head of its tail keeps watch. The tail doesn't need to sleep.

cards.name: Whismur
cards.description: It usually murmurs but starts crying loudly if it senses danger. It stops when its ear covers are shut.

cards.name: Loudred
cards.description: It shouts loudly by inhaling air, and then using its well-developed stomach muscles to exhale.

cards.name: Exploud
cards.description: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.

cards.name: Regigigas
cards.description: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

cards.name: Bunnelby
cards.description: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

cards.name: Diggersby
cards.description: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.

cards.name: Fletchling
cards.description: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

cards.name: Fletchinder
cards.description: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.

cards.name: Furfrou
cards.description: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
